title: SceneAxi propose/apply proposal (v1)
description: Versioned proposal artifact produced by propose() and consumed by apply(). Carries base content hashes for conflict detection, JSON Pointer edits, and unified diffs for review. Multi-document proposals apply all-or-nothing. Behavioral semantics: docs/authoring-contracts.md (E1).

schemaVersion.description: Proposal contract major version. Major mismatch on apply refuses.

edits.description: Ordered pointer edits. Apply is all-or-nothing across every edit.

documentPath.description: Path to the text-canonical document relative to the apply working directory, or absolute.

baseContentHash.description: Content hash of the base document bytes at propose time. Apply refuses on mismatch.

jsonPointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the document (empty string addresses the whole document).

oldValue.description: Value at the pointer on the base document (any JSON type, including null).

newValue.description: Replacement value (any JSON type, including null).

diffs.description: Unified diffs per touched document path (review surface).

unifiedDiff.description: Unified diff (---/+++/@@ hunks) of the text-canonical document before → after.
